description: This PHP source file defines the Utils class within the JmesPath namespace, providing utility functions for type determination, object and array checks, comparison, sorting, and slicing related to JMESPath operations.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for type handling, comparison, sorting, and slicing in the context of JMESPath processing.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Checks if a value is considered truthy in JMESPath context.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the JMESPath type equivalent of a PHP variable.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Determines if a value can be considered a JMESPath-compatible object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Determines if a value can be considered a JMESPath-compatible array.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Performs JSON-aware comparison between two values.

methods.name: stableSort
methods.description: Performs a stable sort on an array using a user-defined comparison function.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a Python-style slice of an array or string.
